policy_definition: When a single OHLC bar can touch both the stop-loss and take-profit levels and the touch order cannot be established from the available evidence, deterministically account for the stop-loss as occurring first.
rationale: Raw trade-path ordering was not extractable through the approved bounded GitHub retrieval path for the seven ambiguity windows.
The policy is fixed, deterministic, outcome-independent, fold-independent, and does not use future information.
The policy avoids optimistic assumptions when OHLC cannot establish intra-bar ordering.
next_gate: Run fail-closed CI with this policy, then only if green authorize Candidate C OOS execution.
